metadata.chapter_title: Carbon Allocation and Net Primary Productivity
metadata.chapter_subtitle: From photosynthesis to biomass — how ecosystems build and burn carbon

inventory.summary: The carbon-allocation chapter needed clearer learner-facing setup so the transition from photosynthesis to pooled biomass modelling felt less abrupt.
issues: The chapter benefited from a more explicit entry ramp into GPP, respiration, and pool allocation.
The ecosystem-carbon sequence needed consistent onboarding across the topic-library environmental chapters.
Readers needed a stronger reminder that turnover rates are as important as allocation fractions.

rewrite.summary: Added stronger opening scaffolding while preserving the multi-pool carbon model and worked example.
editor_notes: Added a Before You Start section focused on flow from GPP to NPP to biomass pools.
Kept the differential-equation treatment because it is appropriate for the volume.
Used the onboarding to slow the transition into allocation coefficients and turnover.

qa_review.summary: The chapter now handles the carbon-flow narrative more clearly while remaining technically correct and well matched to the topic-library level.

repair.summary: The repair was pedagogical rather than structural: better opening guidance around the carbon-flow logic and pool behaviour.
actions_taken: Added a Before You Start section.
Clarified the sequence from carbon fixation to storage.
Preserved the existing model derivation and worked example.

design_review.summary: The chapter already uses visual and interactive explanation well, and the new framing improves interpretation of the pool dynamics.
improvements_made: Added learner-facing prerequisites and reading guidance.
Preserved the chapter's multi-pool simulation and worked example structure.
Improved interpretive support around respiration and turnover.
